 Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Trump says 'we won' Iran war during Veterans Day service
 US President Donald Trump placed a wreath at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier before making remarks at the Veterans Day ceremony at Arlington National Cemetery. Trump spoke about the ongoing US-Iran war, saying that "we won" but it's "just a question of when we want to end it." Arlington National Cemetery is a short distance away from Memorial Circle, the proposed site for Trump's 250-foot triumphal arch.
